title: Gujarat Mukhyamantri Amrutam Vatsalya (MA Vatsalya) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health protection extension associated with Gujarat's Mukhyamantri Amrutam programme for additional eligible vulnerable families.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows Gujarat's currently notified beneficiary/income/category criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Gujarat Mukhyamantri Amrutam Vatsalya (MA Vatsalya).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
